lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular 2D grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with inter-centroid spacing exhibiting a gradual increase along the longitudinal axis towards the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a localized grid pattern where the blobs serve as the primary nodes of intersection.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature running horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity reflectance on the dorsal edge and a shadow-induced low-intensity band on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high-frequency distribution of small, high-luminance spots concentrated along its leading edge and dorsal surface, contrasting with the larger, more widely spaced blobs on the lateral flank.
